name: Camp Ignite
org: Camp Ignite Society (with Metro Vancouver fire departments)
what_you_do: A firefighting camp for young women. Real firefighters are your mentors. Learn to cut people from cars, handle dangerous spills, rope rescue, first aid, fitness and teamwork.
who_can_apply: Girls who are in grade 12 or will enter it in 2026 and live in British Columbia (2026 camp).
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page read. Run by a not-for-profit that aims to keep it affordable.
duration: Three full days, Aug 7 to 9, 2026 (the page also has a four-day, three-night description, so confirm)
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. 2026 camp was Aug 7 to 9. Next year not posted.
how_to_apply: Watch campignite.com for the next form. Email info@campignite.com. Do not email to ask how your form is going.
notes: Camp page is inconsistent: it says three days and also four days three nights. Confirm details on the next posting. Other Ignite camps run on Vancouver Island and in the Kootenays.
